column1: # One line per judge cell. judge.job --array=N reads line N (0-based, comments
# and blank lines skipped):  grep -vE '^\s*(#|$)' grid.tsv | nl -v0 -ba
# tag            directory under results/$RUN/ the cell writes into
# model          HF id, pre-downloaded by setup.sh (jobs run HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1)
# frame          --bbox-frame: pixel (the committed runs) or norm1000 (#5)
# maxlen         --max-model-len; 8192 for InternVL at 6 tiles (2 x 7 x 256 image tokens)
# util           --gpu-util; one value per model across the whole grid
# profile        manifest: out/manifest_<profile>.parquet, built by gate.job
# shard of       hash shard of the manifest
# Order is priority: tasks start roughly in index order when GPUs are scarce.
# tag              model                       frame     tiles maxlen util  profile     presentation    shard of
# --- main, Qwen3-VL-8B, boxes in the model's own 0-1000 frame (#5 fix)
# --- main, InternVL3-8B, 0-1000 boxes, 6 tiles (#8: the second family, at 8B)
# --- nuisance + exploitability on the 476 clean controls, Qwen, 0-1000 boxes
# --- main, Qwen3-VL-8B, pixel boxes: the committed protocol on A100. Exists to
#     separate the hardware change from the frame change (compare_runs.py).
#     LAST on purpose: on a busy partition the cells the report needs run
#     first, and these can be cancelled (scancel <job>_[24-28]) if time runs out.
